See also: Wasabi

English

[edit]
English Wikipedia has an article on:
wasabi
Wikipedia

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Japanese 山葵 (wasabi).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /wəˈsɑːbi/
  • Audio (Southern England):(file)
  • enPR: wä'sə-bē, wə-sä'-bē
  • Rhymes: -ɑːbi

Noun

[edit]

wasabi (usually uncountable, plural wasabis)

  1. A plant of the species Eutrema japonicum, cultivated for its edible root.
  2. A pungent green Japanese condiment made from the plant Eutrema japonicum (syn. Wasabia japonica).
  3. An imitation of this condiment made from horseradish with green dye.

Synonyms

[edit]
  • Japanese horseradish
  • green mustard
